# cosmo_organization_group (Data Source)

Retrieves an organization group by name, including the built-in `admin` group, which cannot be managed with the `cosmo_organization_group` resource. Use it to look up the ID of an existing group, for example to assign it to a `cosmo_api_key`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cosmo_organization_group" "test" {
  name = var.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the group.

### Read-Only

- `builtin` (Boolean) Whether the group is one of the organization's built-in groups.
- `description` (String) The description of the group.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the group.
- `rules` (Attributes Set) The roles granted by the group. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))

<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Read-Only:

- `namespaces` (Set of String) Namespace IDs the role is limited to. Null when not limited by namespace.
- `resources` (Set of String) Target IDs the role is limited to. Null when not limited by resource.
- `role` (String) The granted role.
